title: See inside a turn: stage events, alarm, smoke test as merge gate
description: Ryan 11-02 approved doing this before sub-agents and host tools. Attempts ran 270s against a 120s TURN_DEADLINE_SECONDS with nothing logged. Add per-stage turn events (session open, mailbox pump, model request, first token, finalize), a CloudWatch alarm on turns not finishing, and make the deployed smoke test gate merges. Builds on PR 652. Gherkin specs.
